observation: Fresh-main inspection found the North Star Run v0.2 schema requires an id beginning with the lowercase literal prefix run-, while RunStore.file() used a case-insensitive matcher. A durable RUN-* storage identity could therefore cross the runtime boundary while violating the checked-in contract.
changes: Make the run- prefix case-sensitive at the storage-id boundary while preserving the pre-existing alphanumeric/hyphen suffix acceptance, including uppercase suffix characters that were already accepted.
Add a focused regression proving lowercase-prefix ids remain accepted and uppercase-prefix ids fail closed.

verification.source_contract_replay: PASS: the storage prefix now follows the case-sensitive ^run- schema contract without broadening or narrowing the existing suffix character class.
verification.bounded_reality_replay: PASS: old /^run-[a-z0-9-]+$/i accepted RUN-abc123; proposed /^run-[A-Za-z0-9-]+$/ rejects it while preserving run-abc123 and run-ABC123.
verification.focused_regression_contract: 1 focused test encoded against the real RunStore.file() boundary.
verification.hosted_runtime: HTTP 502 transient upstream error from Developer Execution Runtime; no hosted test pass claimed.

truth_boundary: This cycle only aligns an already-published lexical prefix invariant and preserves the existing storage filename safety policy. It does not choose new authentication or persistence architecture.
